subject: Conference follow-up: inference for transaction monitoring
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moore <alex.moore@fintechx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Great to meet you at FinTech Summit  inference for transaction monitoring

Hi Alex 

It was great to meet you at the FinTech Summit last week. I enjoyed our conversation about real-time transaction monitoring and the challenges you mentioned around latency and cost at scale. A quick recap and suggested next steps: 

- What I heard: FinTechX is evaluating inline ML for fraud scoring across 3m monthly transactions, strict P99 latency targets, and a requirement for private deployment options for certain flows.
- How Redwood can help: unified serving for hosted/dedicated/private, smart KV-caching for repeated prefixes, and batching strategies that lower per-token cost without compromising P99s.
- Mutual action plan: 1) I'll share a short deck with a recommended architecture and pricing ballpark; 2) if useful, schedule a 30-min technical/ops sync with your infra and security folks.

Attached is a tailored 2-slide deck with rough performance benchmarks and a reference config. Proposed times for a 30-min sync next week: Tue 4/13 10:0011:30 PT or Wed 4/14 2:004:00 PT. If those don't work, here's my booking link: https://calendly.com/camila-redwood/30min

Thanks  looking forward to continuing the conversation.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198
[Attachment: Redwood_Deck_FinTechX.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)]

Just wanted to bump this in case it got buried. Any chance you had time to look at the deck? Happy to tailor the architecture sketch further for your specific throughput and retention requirements.

If now isn't the right time, no worries  can you share whether this is high/medium/low priority for Q2? Quick answer helps me recommend an appropriate next step (short technical deep-dive vs. an intro call).

Camila

Hi Alex 

Following up again since I didn't hear back. If the team is heads-down on other priorities, I can:

- Send a 1pager (architecture + expected unit economics)
- Book a 15min quick intro with our solutions engineer to run through latency/cost tradeoffs
- Share SOC 2 summary and deployment options for private workloads

Camila

From: Alex Moore <alex.moore@fintechx.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@fintechx.com
Date: Fri, 22 Apr 2027 10:58:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Great to meet you at FinTech Summit  inference for transaction monitoring

Hi Camila 

Apologies for the slow reply  we've been prioritizing a core merchant onboarding project. This is still on our roadmap but slipped a couple of sprints.

Quick asks from our side so we can evaluate:
1) Can you send a onepage summary that highlights the latency guarantees, typical throughput per GPU, and a pricing ballpark for 3M monthly transactions?
2) We need SOC 2 summary and confirmation about whether the private deployment supports our on-prem HSM (we have an HSM in our PCI zone).
3) Procurement asked for a rough timeline and any typical contract vehicles (SaaS + reserved capacity). I've attached our procurement timeline spreadsheet.

If you can send a short packet, I'll share with infra and procurement and revert with next availability  likely early May.

Thanks,
Alex Moore
Head of Infrastructure, FinTechX
[Attachment: FinTechX_procurement_timeline.xlsx]
